stem: What is the best paraphrase of these sentences?
instruction:
Read these sentences from paragraph 6.

*It builds strength in communities. It encourages people to care about the place where they live.*

options.label: A
options.text: It brings strong people to a community who will take care of their neighbors.

options.label: B
options.text: It adds strength to the relationships between people who live in a place.

options.label: C
options.text: It lets people pick up trash around their towns and build strong gardens.

options.label: D
options.text: It makes communities stronger and helps people care for where they live.

visual_elements: It builds strength in communities. It encourages people to care about the place where they live.
